description: Says what changed in a spec between two versions, so a build of an earlier version can be brought up to date without starting over. Give from, the version that was built: spekkr.inputs.json in the build's folder names it. to is the newest when left out. The answer has the changelog entries in between, the files added, removed and changed, the changed lines of text files, and the requirement ids (R1, R2 and so on) that changed. If from is no longer kept, it says so and gives the changelog alone.

from.description: The earlier version, like 1.3.0: the one the build was made from.

to.description: The later version. Leave it out for the newest.

name: get_spec_changes
title: See what changed between versions
